notes.title: Remote Play Together on Reign and Rumble
notes.content:
[h2]🎮 How to Play [i]Reign and Rumble[/i] via Steam Remote Play Together[/h2][p][i]Reign and Rumble[/i] supports [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b], a free Steam feature that lets you play local multiplayer games online with your friends — as if you were on the same couch![/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ What You Need[/h3][list][*][p][i]Reign and Rumble[/i] installed on the [b]host's PC[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]Steam account[/b] for each player (free).[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]stable internet connection[/b] (wired/Ethernet is recommended for the host).[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]controller[/b] for every player (including the host).[/p][/*][*][p]Steam’s [b]in-game overlay enabled[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Steps for the HOST (the player who owns the game)[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Launch Steam[/b] and log in to your account.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Important] Enable Steam Overlay[/b] (if not already enabled):[/p][list][*][p]Go to [b]Steam > Settings > In-Game[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Check [b]“Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]OK[/b] to save.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Plug in your controller[/b] (required to play).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Launch [i]Reign and Rumble[/i][/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Once you're in the game menu, open the [b]Steam overlay[/b]:
→ Press [b]Shift + Tab[/b] on keyboard (or the Steam button on your controller).[/p][/*][*][p]In your [b]Friends List[/b], right-click on a friend and select:
🎮 [b]Remote Play Together[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Steam will send them an invitation. Once accepted, they will see your screen and join the game using their [b]own controller[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]👥 Steps for INVITED PLAYERS[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Accept the Steam invitation[/b] (from the popup or chat).[/p][/*][*][p]Once connected, you'll see the host's game screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Connect your controller[/b] (required).[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll be able to control your character once the host gives you input access.[/p][/*][/olist][p]💡 The host can manage input permissions via the Steam overlay during the session.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Tips & Troubleshooting[/h3][list][*][p]🎮 If your controller isn’t working:[/p][list][*][p]Go to [b]Steam > Settings > Controller > General Controller Settings[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Make sure your controller type is detected and enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart Steam if necessary.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🌐 For a smoother connection:[/p][list][*][p]The host should use a wired (Ethernet) connection.[/p][/*][*][p]Close other apps that consume bandwidth (YouTube, Discord video, downloads, etc.).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🎤 Steam voice chat is enabled by default but can be turned off in the Remote Play settings.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: - Reign and Rumble supports Steam Remote Play Together, a free Steam feature that lets you play local multiplayer games online with your friends — as if you were on the same couch!
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin

notes.title: Devlog - Game Update 18/07/25
notes.content: [p]This update enhances the local multiplayer experience with new mechanics, bug fixes, and visual and functional improvements. Thank you for your feedback, and stay tuned for more updates![/p][h2][b]New Features and Improvements[/b][/h2][h3][b]Snowball Fight[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Variant - Stun Bonus[/b]: New stun mechanic that disables other players' inputs for 1-2 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Variant - Fast Gift Spawn[/b]: Bonus gifts now spawn more quickly to enhance gameplay dynamics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Self-Hit[/b]: Fixed an issue where shooting while moving forward caused players to hit themselves with their own snowball. Replaced the delay with a check on the instigator of the shot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Freeze[/b]: Added a safety mechanism for unfreezing to prevent control lockups during simultaneous freeze/unfreeze (especially after unfreezing via a campfire).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Campfire[/b]: Added a visible circular zone around campfires to indicate their range. Redesigned this zone for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detection Zone Reduction[/b]: Adjusted snowball collision zones to make the game slightly harder and prevent unintended collisions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Variant - VFX[/b]: Fixed blurry lightning VFX.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Pickup[/b]: Resolved an issue where spamming the snowball pickup key could lock the player in place.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b]: Character UI elements now disappear when the timer reaches 0.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Variant - Lighthouse[/b]: Fixed the lighthouse light beam not appearing on water.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Hide and Seek[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Variant - Prop Clone[/b]: Hiders can now duplicate their own prop in predefined zones during the hiding phase.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Variant - Mud Zone[/b]: Added mud zones that slow down all players passing through them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Score[/b]: Fixed an issue where the score menu doubled up when the timer ended simultaneously with the last shot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collisions[/b]: Revised collision zones to eliminate blind spots and improve fluidity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vibration[/b]: Added controller vibration for the player picking up a gift and for those jumping when the seeker picks up a gift.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Soccer[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Mechanic[/b]: Diving into the ball now propels it with greater force.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Respawn[/b]: Fixed an issue with incorrect teleportation during respawn. Added an input flush to cancel all ongoing actions during respawn.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mini Golf[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Clipping[/b]: Resolved an issue where players could fall through the terrain. Added a collision mesh under the map and a safety mechanism for clipping cases.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collisions[/b]: Revised collision zones for improved stability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]King of the Hill[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix - Cannon[/b]: Fixed an issue preventing the cannon from reaching the main crate.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Menu - Navigation[/b]: Fixed a navigation issue in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Menu - Wishlist Button[/b]: Added a button to add the game to a wishlist.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mini-Game Menu[/b]: Added a short delay before the mini-game selection UI appears to prevent accidental selections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Menu - Camera Transition[/b]: Revised camera transition under the tent to avoid issues with multiple players.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Podium[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Lighting[/b]: Fixed lighting for the savable endgame photo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save Feedback[/b]: Added a "Photo Saved" confirmation message after saving a photo, followed by an automatic return to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Impact Force[/b]: Adjusted the force for hitting the podium, as the previous one was too strong.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Accessories[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Placement[/b]: Revised accessory placement to fix items slightly floating above characters’ heads.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Emotes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Emote[/b]: Added Sunekit’s emote (winner of Reign And Rumble Tournament) [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mapping[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Affordance[/b]: Reviewed and improved affordance in the mapping of various mini-games for better readability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Stun Mechanic[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Vibration[/b]: Added controller vibration during the stun for better haptic feedback.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]Variant - Stun Bonus[/b]: New stun mechanic that disables other players' inputs for 1-2 seconds.
[b]Variant - Fast Gift Spawn[/b]: Bonus gifts now spawn more quickly to enhance gameplay dynamics.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix - Self-Hit[/b]: Fixed an issue where shooting while moving forward caused players to hit themselves with their own snowball. Replaced the delay with a check on the instigator of the shot.
[b]Bug Fix - Freeze[/b]: Added a safety mechanism for unfreezing to prevent control lockups during simultaneous freeze/unfreeze (especially after unfreezing via a campfire).

tags.feature: [b]Campfire[/b]: Added a visible circular zone around campfires to indicate their range. Redesigned this zone for better clarity.

tags.balance_change: [b]Detection Zone Reduction[/b]: Adjusted snowball collision zones to make the game slightly harder and prevent unintended collisions.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix - Pickup[/b]: Resolved an issue where spamming the snowball pickup key could lock the player in place.

tags.feature: [b]UI[/b]: Character UI elements now disappear when the timer reaches 0.

tags.bug: [b]Variant - Lighthouse[/b]: Fixed the lighthouse light beam not appearing on water.

tags.feature: [b]Variant - Prop Clone[/b]: Hiders can now duplicate their own prop in predefined zones during the hiding phase.
[b]Variant - Mud Zone[/b]: Added mud zones that slow down all players passing through them.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix - Score[/b]: Fixed an issue where the score menu doubled up when the timer ended simultaneously with the last shot.

tags.balance_change: [b]Collisions[/b]: Revised collision zones to eliminate blind spots and improve fluidity.

tags.feature: [b]Vibration[/b]: Added controller vibration for the player picking up a gift and for those jumping when the seeker picks up a gift.

tags.balance_change: [b]Mechanic[/b]: Diving into the ball now propels it with greater force.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix - Respawn[/b]: Fixed an issue with incorrect teleportation during respawn. Added an input flush to cancel all ongoing actions during respawn.
[b]Bug Fix - Clipping[/b]: Resolved an issue where players could fall through the terrain. Added a collision mesh under the map and a safety mechanism for clipping cases.

tags.balance_change: [b]Collisions[/b]: Revised collision zones for improved stability.

tags.bug: [b]Bug Fix - Cannon[/b]: Fixed an issue preventing the cannon from reaching the main crate.
[b]Main Menu - Navigation[/b]: Fixed a navigation issue in the main menu.

tags.feature: [b]Main Menu - Wishlist Button[/b]: Added a button to add the game to a wishlist.
[b]Mini-Game Menu[/b]: Added a short delay before the mini-game selection UI appears to prevent accidental selections.
[b]Room Menu - Camera Transition[/b]: Revised camera transition under the tent to avoid issues with multiple players.

tags.bug: [b]Lighting[/b]: Fixed lighting for the savable endgame photo.

tags.feature: [b]Save Feedback[/b]: Added a

tags.balance_change: [b]Impact Force[/b]: Adjusted the force for hitting the podium, as the previous one was too strong.
[b]Placement[/b]: Revised accessory placement to fix items slightly floating above characters’ heads.

tags.feature: [b]New Emote[/b]: Added Sunekit’s emote (winner of Reign And Rumble Tournament)

tags.balance_change: [b]Affordance[/b]: Reviewed and improved affordance in the mapping of various mini-games for better readability.

tags.feature: [b]Vibration[/b]: Added controller vibration during the stun for better haptic feedback.

notes.title: Devlog - Game Update 13/06
notes.content:
[h1][b]Devlog - Game Update[/b][/h1][h2][b]New Features and Improvements[/b][/h2][h3][b]Hide and Seek[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Semi-procedural Map[/b]: The map now changes between sessions to provide a varied and refreshed experience each time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Mechanic[/b]: Hidden players still alive will jump once at 8 seconds from the end, giving the seeker a final chance to spot them.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Headball[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue with respawning after a goal. Player movement is now reset immediately after a goal to prevent positional desync during the reset.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Skin[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Skins[/b]: Added "Cap" and "Cape" skins for StreamMates, offering more customization options.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]User Interface (UI)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Translation[/b]: Added French translation for the entire game, making it more accessible.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Controls (Input)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Emotes[/b]: Added a dedicated key for emotes (D-pad up), enhancing player interactions.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Emotes[/b]: Integrated StreamMate emotes into the menu for added interactivity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text Alignment Fix[/b]: Adjusted a text in the mini-game selection menu that was no longer centered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Link Fixes[/b]: Resolved issues with the main menu buttons (Discord and Linktree) not redirecting to the correct web pages.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Podium[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Visual Improvement[/b]: Replaced the "Never Stream" podium texture with a fade-in effect for a smoother and more polished presentation.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Tutorial[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Videos[/b]: Added new tutorial videos to guide players through the game’s mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Notes[/b][/h2][p]This update aims to enhance the local multiplayer experience while fixing bugs and adding content to improve interaction and customization. Thank you for your feedback, and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: Semi-procedural Map: The map now changes between sessions to provide a varied and refreshed experience each time.
Endgame Mechanic: Hidden players still alive will jump once at 8 seconds from the end, giving the seeker a final chance to spot them.

tags.bug: Bug Fix: Fixed an issue with respawning after a goal. Player movement is now reset immediately after a goal to prevent positional desync during the reset.

tags.feature: New Skins: Added "Cap" and "Cape" skins for StreamMates, offering more customization options.
Translation: Added French translation for the entire game, making it more accessible.
Emotes: Added a dedicated key for emotes (D-pad up), enhancing player interactions.
New Emotes: Integrated StreamMate emotes into the menu for added interactivity.

tags.bug: Text Alignment Fix: Adjusted a text in the mini-game selection menu that was no longer centered.
Link Fixes: Resolved issues with the main menu buttons (Discord and Linktree) not redirecting to the correct web pages.

tags.feature: Visual Improvement: Replaced the "Never Stream" podium texture with a fade-in effect for a smoother and more polished presentation.
New Videos: Added new tutorial videos to guide players through the game’s mechanics.
